import uuid

from django.contrib.auth.models import User
from django.db import models
from django.utils import timezone

from users.models import FamilyGroup


class StripeCustomer(models.Model):
    """Links Django users to Stripe customers"""

    id = models.UUIDField(default=uuid.uuid4, primary_key=True, editable=False)
    user = models.OneToOneField(
        User, on_delete=models.CASCADE, related_name="stripe_customer"
    )
    stripe_customer_id = models.CharField(max_length=255, unique=True, db_index=True)
    created_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True)
    updated_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now=True)

    class Meta:
        db_table = "payments_stripecustomer"
        verbose_name = "Stripe Customer"
        verbose_name_plural = "Stripe Customers"

    def __str__(self):
        return f"{self.user.username} - {self.stripe_customer_id}"


class SubscriptionTier(models.Model):
    """Defines available subscription tiers"""

    STARTER = "starter"
    COMPLETE = "complete"
    NETWORK = "network"

    TIER_CHOICES = [
        (STARTER, "Family Starter"),
        (COMPLETE, "Family Complete"),
        (NETWORK, "Family Premier"),
    ]

    id = models.UUIDField(default=uuid.uuid4, primary_key=True, editable=False)
    name = models.CharField(max_length=50, choices=TIER_CHOICES, unique=True)
    display_name = models.CharField(max_length=100)
    price_monthly = models.DecimalField(max_digits=10, decimal_places=2)
    max_family_members = models.IntegerField(
        null=True, blank=True, help_text="null = unlimited"
    )
    max_calendar_syncs = models.IntegerField(
        null=True, blank=True, help_text="null = unlimited"
    )
    max_monthly_trips = models.IntegerField(
        null=True, blank=True, help_text="null = unlimited"
    )
    features = models.JSONField(default=dict, help_text="Store feature flags")
    stripe_price_id = models.CharField(max_length=255, unique=True)
    is_active = models.BooleanField(default=True)
    created_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True)
    updated_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now=True)

    class Meta:
        db_table = "payments_subscriptiontier"
        verbose_name = "Subscription Tier"
        verbose_name_plural = "Subscription Tiers"
        ordering = ["price_monthly"]

    def __str__(self):
        return f"{self.display_name} - ${self.price_monthly}/month"


# Subscription status choices
SUBSCRIPTION_STATUS_CHOICES = [
    ("trialing", "Trialing"),
    ("active", "Active"),
    ("incomplete", "Incomplete"),
    ("incomplete_expired", "Incomplete Expired"),
    ("past_due", "Past Due"),
    ("canceled", "Canceled"),
    ("unpaid", "Unpaid"),
]


class Subscription(models.Model):
    """Tracks family subscriptions"""

    id = models.UUIDField(default=uuid.uuid4, primary_key=True, editable=False)
    family = models.OneToOneField(
        FamilyGroup, on_delete=models.CASCADE, related_name="subscription"
    )
    tier = models.ForeignKey(
        SubscriptionTier,
        on_delete=models.PROTECT,
        related_name="subscriptions",
    )
    stripe_subscription_id = models.CharField(
        max_length=255, unique=True, db_index=True
    )
    customer = models.ForeignKey(
        StripeCustomer,
        on_delete=models.CASCADE,
        related_name="subscriptions",
    )
    status = models.CharField(max_length=50, choices=SUBSCRIPTION_STATUS_CHOICES)
    current_period_start = models.DateTimeField()
    current_period_end = models.DateTimeField()
    cancel_at_period_end = models.BooleanField(default=False)
    trial_end = models.DateTimeField(null=True, blank=True)
    created_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True)
    updated_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now=True)

    class Meta:
        db_table = "payments_subscription"
        verbose_name = "Subscription"
        verbose_name_plural = "Subscriptions"
        indexes = [
            models.Index(fields=["family", "status"]),
            models.Index(fields=["status"]),
        ]

    def __str__(self):
        return f"{self.family.name} - {self.tier.display_name} ({self.status})"

    def can_create_trip(self):
        """Check if family can create another trip this month"""
        if self.tier.max_monthly_trips is None:
            return True

        from trips.models import Trip

        current_month_trips = Trip.objects.filter(
            family_groups=self.family,
            created_at__month=timezone.now().month,
            created_at__year=timezone.now().year,
        ).count()

        return current_month_trips < self.tier.max_monthly_trips

    def can_add_family_member(self):
        """Check if family can add another member"""
        if self.tier.max_family_members is None:
            return True

        current_members = self.family.memberships.count()
        return current_members < self.tier.max_family_members

    def can_add_calendar_sync(self):
        """Check if family can add another calendar sync"""
        if self.tier.max_calendar_syncs is None:
            return True

        # This will need to be updated when calendar sync model is available
        # For now, return True
        return True

    @property
    def is_active_or_trialing(self):
        """Check if subscription is in an active state"""
        return self.status in ["active", "trialing"]


class PaymentMethod(models.Model):
    """Stores payment method references"""

    CARD = "card"
    BANK_ACCOUNT = "bank_account"

    TYPE_CHOICES = [
        (CARD, "Card"),
        (BANK_ACCOUNT, "Bank Account"),
    ]

    id = models.UUIDField(default=uuid.uuid4, primary_key=True, editable=False)
    customer = models.ForeignKey(
        StripeCustomer,
        on_delete=models.CASCADE,
        related_name="payment_methods",
    )
    stripe_payment_method_id = models.CharField(max_length=255, unique=True)
    type = models.CharField(max_length=50, choices=TYPE_CHOICES)
    last4 = models.CharField(max_length=4)
    brand = models.CharField(max_length=50, null=True, blank=True)
    is_default = models.BooleanField(default=False)
    created_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True)
    updated_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now=True)

    class Meta:
        db_table = "payments_paymentmethod"
        verbose_name = "Payment Method"
        verbose_name_plural = "Payment Methods"
        indexes = [
            models.Index(fields=["customer", "is_default"]),
        ]

    def __str__(self):
        if self.brand:
            return f"{self.brand} ****{self.last4}"
        return f"{self.get_type_display()} ****{self.last4}"

    def save(self, *args, **kwargs):
        # Ensure only one default payment method per customer
        if self.is_default:
            PaymentMethod.objects.filter(
                customer=self.customer, is_default=True
            ).exclude(pk=self.pk).update(is_default=False)
        super().save(*args, **kwargs)


# Invoice status choices
INVOICE_STATUS_CHOICES = [
    ("draft", "Draft"),
    ("open", "Open"),
    ("paid", "Paid"),
    ("uncollectible", "Uncollectible"),
    ("void", "Void"),
]


class Invoice(models.Model):
    """Mirrors Stripe invoices"""

    id = models.UUIDField(default=uuid.uuid4, primary_key=True, editable=False)
    stripe_invoice_id = models.CharField(max_length=255, unique=True, db_index=True)
    subscription = models.ForeignKey(
        Subscription,
        on_delete=models.CASCADE,
        related_name="invoices",
    )
    amount_paid = models.DecimalField(max_digits=10, decimal_places=2)
    amount_due = models.DecimalField(max_digits=10, decimal_places=2)
    currency = models.CharField(max_length=3, default="usd")
    status = models.CharField(max_length=50, choices=INVOICE_STATUS_CHOICES)
    period_start = models.DateTimeField()
    period_end = models.DateTimeField()
    pdf_url = models.URLField(max_length=500, null=True, blank=True)
    created_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True)
    updated_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now=True)

    class Meta:
        db_table = "payments_invoice"
        verbose_name = "Invoice"
        verbose_name_plural = "Invoices"
        ordering = ["-created_at"]
        indexes = [
            models.Index(fields=["subscription", "status"]),
            models.Index(fields=["created_at"]),
        ]

    def __str__(self):
        return f"Invoice {self.stripe_invoice_id} - ${self.amount_due} ({self.status})"


class PaymentEvent(models.Model):
    """Tracks all payment-related events for auditing"""

    id = models.UUIDField(default=uuid.uuid4, primary_key=True, editable=False)
    stripe_event_id = models.CharField(max_length=255, unique=True, db_index=True)
    event_type = models.CharField(max_length=100)
    data = models.JSONField()
    processed = models.BooleanField(default=False)
    error_message = models.TextField(null=True, blank=True)
    created_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True)
    processed_at = models.DateTimeField(null=True, blank=True)

    class Meta:
        db_table = "payments_paymentevent"
        verbose_name = "Payment Event"
        verbose_name_plural = "Payment Events"
        ordering = ["-created_at"]
        indexes = [
            models.Index(fields=["event_type", "processed"]),
            models.Index(fields=["created_at"]),
        ]

    def __str__(self):
        return f"{self.event_type} - {self.stripe_event_id} ({'processed' if self.processed else 'pending'})"

import uuid

from django.contrib.auth.models import User
from django.db import models
from django.utils import timezone

from users.models import FamilyGroup


class StripeCustomer(models.Model):
    """Links Django users to Stripe customers"""

    id = models.UUIDField(default=uuid.uuid4, primary_key=True, editable=False)
    user = models.OneToOneField(
        User, on_delete=models.CASCADE, related_name="stripe_customer"
    )
    stripe_customer_id = models.CharField(max_length=255, unique=True, db_index=True)
    created_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True)
    updated_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now=True)

    class Meta:
        db_table = "payments_stripecustomer"
        verbose_name = "Stripe Customer"
        verbose_name_plural = "Stripe Customers"

    def __str__(self) -> str:
        return f"{self.user.username} - {self.stripe_customer_id}"


class SubscriptionTier(models.Model):
    """Defines available subscription tiers"""

    STARTER = "starter"
    COMPLETE = "complete"
    NETWORK = "network"

    TIER_CHOICES = [
        (STARTER, "Family Starter"),
        (COMPLETE, "Family Complete"),
        (NETWORK, "Family Premier"),
    ]

    id = models.UUIDField(default=uuid.uuid4, primary_key=True, editable=False)
    name = models.CharField(max_length=50, choices=TIER_CHOICES, unique=True)
    display_name = models.CharField(max_length=100)
    price_monthly = models.DecimalField(max_digits=10, decimal_places=2)
    max_family_members = models.IntegerField(
        null=True, blank=True, help_text="null = unlimited"
    )
    max_calendar_syncs = models.IntegerField(
        null=True, blank=True, help_text="null = unlimited"
    )
    max_monthly_trips = models.IntegerField(
        null=True, blank=True, help_text="null = unlimited"
    )
    features = models.JSONField(default=dict, help_text="Store feature flags")
    stripe_price_id = models.CharField(max_length=255, unique=True)
    is_active = models.BooleanField(default=True)
    created_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True)
    updated_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now=True)

    class Meta:
        db_table = "payments_subscriptiontier"
        verbose_name = "Subscription Tier"
        verbose_name_plural = "Subscription Tiers"
        ordering = ["price_monthly"]

    def __str__(self) -> str:
        return f"{self.display_name} - ${self.price_monthly}/month"


# Subscription status choices
SUBSCRIPTION_STATUS_CHOICES = [
    ("trialing", "Trialing"),
    ("active", "Active"),
    ("incomplete", "Incomplete"),
    ("incomplete_expired", "Incomplete Expired"),
    ("past_due", "Past Due"),
    ("canceled", "Canceled"),
    ("unpaid", "Unpaid"),
]


class Subscription(models.Model):
    """Tracks family subscriptions"""

    id = models.UUIDField(default=uuid.uuid4, primary_key=True, editable=False)
    family = models.OneToOneField(
        FamilyGroup, on_delete=models.CASCADE, related_name="subscription"
    )
    tier = models.ForeignKey(
        SubscriptionTier,
        on_delete=models.PROTECT,
        related_name="subscriptions",
    )
    stripe_subscription_id = models.CharField(
        max_length=255, unique=True, db_index=True
    )
    customer = models.ForeignKey(
        StripeCustomer,
        on_delete=models.CASCADE,
        related_name="subscriptions",
    )
    status = models.CharField(max_length=50, choices=SUBSCRIPTION_STATUS_CHOICES)
    current_period_start = models.DateTimeField()
    current_period_end = models.DateTimeField()
    cancel_at_period_end = models.BooleanField(default=False)
    trial_end = models.DateTimeField(null=True, blank=True)
    created_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True)
    updated_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now=True)

    class Meta:
        db_table = "payments_subscription"
        verbose_name = "Subscription"
        verbose_name_plural = "Subscriptions"
        indexes = [
            models.Index(fields=["family", "status"]),
            models.Index(fields=["status"]),
        ]

    def __str__(self) -> str:
        return f"{self.family.name} - {self.tier.display_name} ({self.status})"

    def can_create_trip(self) -> bool:
        """Check if family can create another trip this month"""
        if self.tier.max_monthly_trips is None:
            return True

        from trips.models import Trip

        current_month_trips = Trip.objects.filter(
            family_groups=self.family,
            created_at__month=timezone.now().month,
            created_at__year=timezone.now().year,
        ).count()

        return current_month_trips < self.tier.max_monthly_trips

    def can_add_family_member(self) -> bool:
        """Check if family can add another member"""
        if self.tier.max_family_members is None:
            return True

        current_members = self.family.memberships.count()
        return current_members < self.tier.max_family_members

    def can_add_calendar_sync(self) -> bool:
        """Check if family can add another calendar sync"""
        if self.tier.max_calendar_syncs is None:
            return True

        # This will need to be updated when calendar sync model is available
        # For now, return True
        return True

    @property
    def is_active_or_trialing(self) -> bool:
        """Check if subscription is in an active state"""
        return self.status in ["active", "trialing"]


class PaymentMethod(models.Model):
    """Stores payment method references"""

    CARD = "card"
    BANK_ACCOUNT = "bank_account"

    TYPE_CHOICES = [
        (CARD, "Card"),
        (BANK_ACCOUNT, "Bank Account"),
    ]

    id = models.UUIDField(default=uuid.uuid4, primary_key=True, editable=False)
    customer = models.ForeignKey(
        StripeCustomer,
        on_delete=models.CASCADE,
        related_name="payment_methods",
    )
    stripe_payment_method_id = models.CharField(max_length=255, unique=True)
    type = models.CharField(max_length=50, choices=TYPE_CHOICES)
    last4 = models.CharField(max_length=4)
    brand = models.CharField(max_length=50, null=True, blank=True)
    is_default = models.BooleanField(default=False)
    created_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True)
    updated_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now=True)

    class Meta:
        db_table = "payments_paymentmethod"
        verbose_name = "Payment Method"
        verbose_name_plural = "Payment Methods"
        indexes = [
            models.Index(fields=["customer", "is_default"]),
        ]

    def __str__(self) -> str:
        if self.brand:
            return f"{self.brand} ****{self.last4}"
        return f"{self.get_type_display()} ****{self.last4}"

    def save(self, *args: object, **kwargs: object) -> None:
        # Ensure only one default payment method per customer
        if self.is_default:
            PaymentMethod.objects.filter(
                customer=self.customer, is_default=True
            ).exclude(pk=self.pk).update(is_default=False)
        super().save(*args, **kwargs)

from rest_framework import serializers

from payments.models import (
    Invoice,
    PaymentEvent,
    PaymentMethod,
    StripeCustomer,
    Subscription,
    SubscriptionTier,
)


class StripeCustomerSerializer(serializers.ModelSerializer):
    user_email = serializers.EmailField(source="user.email", read_only=True)
    user_name = serializers.SerializerMethodField()

    class Meta:
        model = StripeCustomer
        fields = [
            "id",
            "user",
            "user_email",
            "user_name",
            "stripe_customer_id",
            "created_at",
            "updated_at",
        ]
        read_only_fields = ["id", "stripe_customer_id", "created_at", "updated_at"]

    def get_user_name(self, obj):
        return (
            f"{obj.user.first_name} {obj.user.last_name}".strip() or obj.user.username
        )


class SubscriptionTierSerializer(serializers.ModelSerializer):
    class Meta:
        model = SubscriptionTier
        fields = [
            "id",
            "name",
            "display_name",
            "price_monthly",
            "max_family_members",
            "max_calendar_syncs",
            "max_monthly_trips",
            "features",
            "is_active",
            "created_at",
        ]
        read_only_fields = ["id", "created_at"]


class SubscriptionSerializer(serializers.ModelSerializer):
    tier = SubscriptionTierSerializer(read_only=True)
    tier_id = serializers.UUIDField(write_only=True, required=False)
    family_name = serializers.CharField(source="family.name", read_only=True)
    customer_email = serializers.EmailField(
        source="customer.user.email", read_only=True
    )
    days_until_renewal = serializers.SerializerMethodField()
    can_create_trip = serializers.SerializerMethodField()
    can_add_family_member = serializers.SerializerMethodField()

    class Meta:
        model = Subscription
        fields = [
            "id",
            "family",
            "family_name",
            "tier",
            "tier_id",
            "stripe_subscription_id",
            "customer",
            "customer_email",
            "status",
            "current_period_start",
            "current_period_end",
            "cancel_at_period_end",
            "trial_end",
            "is_active_or_trialing",
            "days_until_renewal",
            "can_create_trip",
            "can_add_family_member",
            "created_at",
            "updated_at",
        ]
        read_only_fields = [
            "id",
            "stripe_subscription_id",
            "customer",
            "current_period_start",
            "current_period_end",
            "created_at",
            "updated_at",
        ]

    def get_days_until_renewal(self, obj):
        from django.utils import timezone

        if obj.current_period_end:
            delta = obj.current_period_end - timezone.now()
            return max(0, delta.days)
        return 0

    def get_can_create_trip(self, obj):
        return obj.can_create_trip()

    def get_can_add_family_member(self, obj):
        return obj.can_add_family_member()


class PaymentMethodSerializer(serializers.ModelSerializer):
    display_name = serializers.SerializerMethodField()

    class Meta:
        model = PaymentMethod
        fields = [
            "id",
            "customer",
            "stripe_payment_method_id",
            "type",
            "last4",
            "brand",
            "is_default",
            "display_name",
            "created_at",
        ]
        read_only_fields = [
            "id",
            "stripe_payment_method_id",
            "type",
            "last4",
            "brand",
            "created_at",
        ]

    def get_display_name(self, obj):
        return str(obj)


class InvoiceSerializer(serializers.ModelSerializer):
    subscription_tier = serializers.CharField(
        source="subscription.tier.display_name", read_only=True
    )
    family_name = serializers.CharField(
        source="subscription.family.name", read_only=True
    )

    class Meta:
        model = Invoice
        fields = [
            "id",
            "stripe_invoice_id",
            "subscription",
            "subscription_tier",
            "family_name",
            "amount_paid",
            "amount_due",
            "currency",
            "status",
            "period_start",
            "period_end",
            "pdf_url",
            "created_at",
        ]
        read_only_fields = fields  # All fields are read-only


class CreateSubscriptionSerializer(serializers.Serializer):
    tier_id = serializers.UUIDField()
    payment_method_id = serializers.CharField(required=False)

    def validate_tier_id(self, value):
        try:
            SubscriptionTier.objects.get(id=value, is_active=True)
        except SubscriptionTier.DoesNotExist as exc:
            raise serializers.ValidationError(
                "Invalid or inactive subscription tier"
            ) from exc
        return value


class UpgradeSubscriptionSerializer(serializers.Serializer):
    new_tier_id = serializers.UUIDField()

    def validate_new_tier_id(self, value):
        try:
            SubscriptionTier.objects.get(id=value, is_active=True)
        except SubscriptionTier.DoesNotExist as exc:
            raise serializers.ValidationError(
                "Invalid or inactive subscription tier"
            ) from exc
        return value


class SetupIntentSerializer(serializers.Serializer):
    client_secret = serializers.CharField(read_only=True)
    setup_intent_id = serializers.CharField(read_only=True)


class BillingPortalSerializer(serializers.Serializer):
    url = serializers.URLField(read_only=True)
    return_url = serializers.URLField(write_only=True)


class PaymentEventSerializer(serializers.ModelSerializer):
    class Meta:
        model = PaymentEvent
        fields = [
            "id",
            "stripe_event_id",
            "event_type",
            "data",
            "processed",
            "error_message",
            "created_at",
            "processed_at",
        ]
        read_only_fields = fields  # All fields are read-only

from typing import Any

from rest_framework import serializers

from payments.models import (
    Invoice,
    PaymentEvent,
    PaymentMethod,
    StripeCustomer,
    Subscription,
    SubscriptionTier,
)


class StripeCustomerSerializer(serializers.ModelSerializer[StripeCustomer]):
    user_email = serializers.EmailField(source="user.email", read_only=True)
    user_name = serializers.SerializerMethodField()

    class Meta:
        model = StripeCustomer
        fields = [
            "id",
            "user",
            "user_email",
            "user_name",
            "stripe_customer_id",
            "created_at",
            "updated_at",
        ]
        read_only_fields = ["id", "stripe_customer_id", "created_at", "updated_at"]

    def get_user_name(self, obj: StripeCustomer) -> str:
        return (
            f"{obj.user.first_name} {obj.user.last_name}".strip() or obj.user.username
        )

        model = Subscription

            "id",

import pytest
from django.contrib.auth.models import User
from django.urls import reverse

from users.models import FamilyGroup, FamilyGroupType, FamilyMembership


@pytest.fixture
def user(db):
    return User.objects.create_user(
        username="testuser",
        email="test@example.com",
        password="testpass123",  # noqa: S106
    )


@pytest.fixture
def non_admin_user(db):
    return User.objects.create_user(
        username="nonadmin",
        email="nonadmin@example.com",
        password="testpass123",  # noqa: S106
    )


@pytest.fixture
def family(db):
    family = FamilyGroup.objects.create(name="Test Family")
    FamilyGroupType.objects.update_or_create(
        family=family, defaults={"type": "IMMEDIATE"}
    )
    return family


@pytest.fixture
def admin_user(user, family):
    FamilyMembership.objects.create(
        user=user, family=family, role="PARENT", is_admin=True
    )
    user.profile.primary_family = family
    user.profile.save()
    return user


@pytest.fixture
def non_admin_member(non_admin_user, family):
    FamilyMembership.objects.create(
        user=non_admin_user, family=family, role="CHILD", is_admin=False
    )
    return non_admin_user


@pytest.mark.django_db
class TestBillingOverview:
    def test_unauthenticated_redirects_to_login(self, client) -> None:
        url = reverse("billing_overview")
        response = client.get(url)
        assert response.status_code == 302
        assert "/accounts/login/" in response.url

        client.login(username="nonadmin", password="testpass123")  # noqa: S106
        url = reverse("billing_overview")
        response = client.get(url)
        assert response.status_code == 403

        client.login(username="testuser", password="testpass123")  # noqa: S106
        url = reverse("billing_overview")
        response = client.get(url)
        assert response.status_code == 200
        assert b"Choose a plan" in response.content
        assert b"Family" in response.content

from decimal import Decimal
from typing import TypedDict

from django.conf import settings
from django.core.management.base import BaseCommand

from payments.models import SubscriptionTier


class _TierSeed(TypedDict):
    name: str
    display_name: str
    price_monthly: Decimal
    max_family_members: int | None
    max_calendar_syncs: int | None
    max_monthly_trips: int | None
    features: dict[str, bool]
    stripe_price_id: str


def seed_subscription_tiers() -> list[SubscriptionTier]:
    """Create or update the launch subscription tiers.

    Keep the bootstrap logic in one place so the management command and the
    billing page's setup action always stay aligned.
    """
    tiers: list[_TierSeed] = [
        {
            "name": SubscriptionTier.STARTER,
            "display_name": "Family",
            "price_monthly": Decimal("3.99"),
            "max_family_members": None,  # Unlimited
            "max_calendar_syncs": None,  # Unlimited
            "max_monthly_trips": None,  # Unlimited
            "features": {
                "core_events": True,
                "notes": True,
                "basic_calendar_sync": True,
                "standard_notifications": True,
                "ai_emails": True,
                "charter_access": True,
                "premium_templates": True,
            },
            "stripe_price_id": settings.STRIPE_STARTER_PRICE_ID or "price_family_test",
        },
    ]

    seeded_tiers: list[SubscriptionTier] = []

    for tier_data in tiers:
        tier, _created = SubscriptionTier.objects.update_or_create(
            name=tier_data["name"],
            defaults={
                "display_name": tier_data["display_name"],
                "price_monthly": tier_data["price_monthly"],
                "max_family_members": tier_data["max_family_members"],
                "max_calendar_syncs": tier_data["max_calendar_syncs"],
                "max_monthly_trips": tier_data["max_monthly_trips"],
                "features": tier_data["features"],
                "stripe_price_id": tier_data["stripe_price_id"],
                "is_active": True,
            },
        )
        seeded_tiers.append(tier)

    # Only the launch tier is active for now; this keeps the web UI and seed
    # command in lockstep until the other tiers are launched.
    SubscriptionTier.objects.exclude(name=SubscriptionTier.STARTER).update(
        is_active=False
    )

    return seeded_tiers


class Command(BaseCommand):
    help = "Seed subscription tiers in the database"

    def handle(self, *args, **options):
        seeded_tiers = seed_subscription_tiers()

        for tier in seeded_tiers:
            self.stdout.write(
                self.style.SUCCESS(
                    f"Created or updated subscription tier: {tier.display_name}"
                )
            )

        self.stdout.write(
            self.style.SUCCESS("\nSuccessfully seeded all subscription tiers!")
        )

        # Display summary
        self.stdout.write("\nSubscription Tiers Summary:")
        for tier in SubscriptionTier.objects.filter(is_active=True).order_by(
            "price_monthly"
        ):
            self.stdout.write(
                f"- {tier.display_name}: ${tier.price_monthly}/month "
                f"(up to {tier.max_family_members or 'unlimited'} members)"
            )

                )

        for event_type, count in sorted(event_stats.items()):
            self.stdout.write(f"  {event_type}: {count}")

        if options["fix"]:
            self.stdout.write(
                self.style.SUCCESS(f"\nTotal events removed: {total_removed}")
            )
        else:

            )

from decimal import Decimal
from typing import TypedDict

from django.conf import settings
from django.core.management.base import BaseCommand

from payments.models import SubscriptionTier


class _TierSeed(TypedDict):
    name: str
    display_name: str
    price_monthly: Decimal
    max_family_members: int | None
    max_calendar_syncs: int | None
    max_monthly_trips: int | None
    features: dict[str, bool]
    stripe_price_id: str


def seed_subscription_tiers() -> list[SubscriptionTier]:
    """Create or update the launch subscription tiers.

    Keep the bootstrap logic in one place so the management command and the
    billing page's setup action always stay aligned.
    """
    tiers: list[_TierSeed] = [
        {
            "name": SubscriptionTier.STARTER,
            "display_name": "Family",
            "price_monthly": Decimal("3.99"),
            "max_family_members": None,  # Unlimited
            "max_calendar_syncs": None,  # Unlimited
            "max_monthly_trips": None,  # Unlimited
            "features": {
                "core_events": True,
                "notes": True,
                "basic_calendar_sync": True,
                "standard_notifications": True,
                "ai_emails": True,
                "charter_access": True,
                "premium_templates": True,
            },
            "stripe_price_id": settings.STRIPE_STARTER_PRICE_ID or "price_family_test",
        },
    ]

    seeded_tiers: list[SubscriptionTier] = []

    for tier_data in tiers:
        tier, _created = SubscriptionTier.objects.update_or_create(
            name=tier_data["name"],
            defaults={
                "display_name": tier_data["display_name"],
                "price_monthly": tier_data["price_monthly"],
                "max_family_members": tier_data["max_family_members"],
                "max_calendar_syncs": tier_data["max_calendar_syncs"],
                "max_monthly_trips": tier_data["max_monthly_trips"],
                "features": tier_data["features"],
                "stripe_price_id": tier_data["stripe_price_id"],
                "is_active": True,
            },
        )
        seeded_tiers.append(tier)

    # Only the launch tier is active for now; this keeps the web UI and seed
    # command in lockstep until the other tiers are launched.
    SubscriptionTier.objects.exclude(name=SubscriptionTier.STARTER).update(
        is_active=False
    )

    return seeded_tiers


class Command(BaseCommand):
    help = "Seed subscription tiers in the database"

    def handle(self, *args: Any, **options: Any) -> None:
        seeded_tiers = seed_subscription_tiers()

        for tier in seeded_tiers:
            self.stdout.write(
                self.style.SUCCESS(
                    f"Created or updated subscription tier: {tier.display_name}"
                )
            )

        self.stdout.write(
            self.style.SUCCESS("\nSuccessfully seeded all subscription tiers!")
        )

        # Display summary
        self.stdout.write("\nSubscription Tiers Summary:")
        for tier in SubscriptionTier.objects.filter(is_active=True).order_by(
            "price_monthly"
        ):
            self.stdout.write(
                f"- {tier.display_name}: ${tier.price_monthly}/month "
                f"(up to {tier.max_family_members or 'unlimited'} members)"
            )

from core.security_logging import security_log_access_denied
from payments.management.commands.seed_subscription_tiers import seed_subscription_tiers
from payments.models import Invoice, Subscription, SubscriptionTier

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


def _get_billing_family(
    user: User, admin_families: QuerySet[FamilyGroup]
) -> FamilyGroup | None:
    """Resolve the family whose billing surface the current admin should manage."""
    profile = getattr(user, "profile", None)
    family = getattr(profile, "primary_family", None) if profile else None
    if family and admin_families.filter(id=family.id).exists():
        return family  # type: ignore[no-any-return]
    return admin_families.first()


@login_required
@ensure_csrf_cookie
def billing_overview(request: HttpRequest) -> HttpResponse:
    """Billing overview page — admin-only, shows subscription or tier selection."""
    user = cast(User, request.user)

    admin_families = get_user_admin_families(user)
    if not admin_families.exists():
        security_log_access_denied(
            user_id=str(user.id),
            action="view_billing",
            object_type="billing_page",
            object_id=None,
            reason="User is not admin in any family",
        )
        return HttpResponseForbidden("You must be a family admin to access billing.")

    family = _get_billing_family(user, admin_families)

    subscription = (
        Subscription.objects.filter(family=family).select_related("tier").first()
    )

    invoices = []
    if subscription:
        invoices = list(
            Invoice.objects.filter(subscription=subscription).order_by("-created_at")[
                :5
            ]
        )

    tiers = list(SubscriptionTier.objects.filter(is_active=True))
    if not tiers:
        # Fresh local/staging databases often miss the one-time tier seed step,
        # which otherwise leaves billing with no way for an admin to continue.
        try:
            tiers = seed_subscription_tiers()
        except Exception:
            logger.exception("Unable to seed default subscription tiers")
            messages.error(
                request,
                "Billing plans could not be loaded. Please try again in a moment.",
            )
            tiers = []
    member_count = family.memberships.filter(is_active=True).count() if family else 0
    mobile_mode = request.GET.get("mobile") == "1"

    context = {
        "subscription": subscription,
        "invoices": invoices,
        "tiers": tiers,
        "member_count": member_count,
        "family": family,
        "mobile_mode": mobile_mode,
    }
    return render(request, "payments/billing.html", context)


@login_required
@require_POST
def billing_setup(request: HttpRequest) -> HttpResponse:
    """Seed the launch billing tier so the billing page has a path forward."""
    user = cast(User, request.user)

    admin_families = get_user_admin_families(user)
    if not admin_families.exists():
        security_log_access_denied(
            user_id=str(user.id),
            action="seed_billing",
            object_type="billing_page",
            object_id=None,
            reason="User is not admin in any family",
        )
        return HttpResponseForbidden("You must be a family admin to access billing.")

    seed_subscription_tiers()
    messages.success(request, "Billing plans are ready.")
    return redirect("billing_overview")


@login_required
@require_POST
def billing_checkout(request: HttpRequest) -> HttpResponse:
    """Create a subscription for the selected tier and return to billing."""
    user = cast(User, request.user)

    admin_families = get_user_admin_families(user)
    if not admin_families.exists():
        security_log_access_denied(
            user_id=str(user.id),
            action="create_billing_checkout",
            object_type="billing_page",
            object_id=None,
            reason="User is not admin in any family",
        )
        return HttpResponseForbidden("You must be a family admin to access billing.")

    tier_id = request.POST.get("tier_id")
    if not tier_id:
        messages.error(request, "Select a billing plan to continue.")
        return redirect("billing_overview")

    family = _get_billing_family(user, admin_families)
    if Subscription.objects.filter(family=family).exists():
        messages.info(request, "Your family already has an active billing plan.")
        return redirect("billing_overview")

    try:
        tier = SubscriptionTier.objects.get(id=tier_id, is_active=True)

        if hasattr(user, "stripe_customer"):
            customer = user.stripe_customer
        else:
            customer = StripeService.create_customer(user)

        StripeService.create_subscription(family, customer, tier)
        messages.success(request, "Your family trial has started.")
    except SubscriptionTier.DoesNotExist:
        messages.error(request, "That billing plan is no longer available.")
    except Exception:
        logger.exception("Unable to start billing checkout for family %s", family.id)
        messages.error(
            request,
            "We couldn't start billing right now. Please try again shortly.",
        )
    return redirect("billing_overview")


@login_required
@require_POST
def billing_portal(request: HttpRequest) -> HttpResponse:
    """Send the customer to Stripe's self-service portal."""
    user = cast(User, request.user)

    admin_families = get_user_admin_families(user)
    if not admin_families.exists():
        security_log_access_denied(
            user_id=str(user.id),
            action="open_billing_portal",
            object_type="billing_page",
            object_id=None,
            reason="User is not admin in any family",
        )
        return HttpResponseForbidden("You must be a family admin to access billing.")

    family = _get_billing_family(user, admin_families)
    subscription = (
        Subscription.objects.filter(family=family).select_related("customer").first()
    )
    if subscription:
        customer = subscription.customer
    elif hasattr(user, "stripe_customer"):
        customer = user.stripe_customer
    else:
        customer = StripeService.create_customer(user)

    return_url = request.POST.get("return_url") or request.build_absolute_uri(
        reverse("billing_overview")
    )
    try:
        url = StripeService.create_billing_portal_session(customer, return_url)
        return redirect(url)
    except Exception:
        logger.exception(
            "Unable to create billing portal session for family %s", family.id
        )
        messages.error(
            request,
            "We couldn't open the billing portal right now. Please try again shortly.",
        )
        return redirect("billing_overview")

content.text:
3 apps strict-clean. Wrap up session.

## Session summary

mypy strict baseline → 7193 strict errors. Now passes with `strict = True` globally plus per-app opt-outs.

**Strict-clean apps:** webhooks/, core/, payments/

**Real bugs fixed:**
- `FamilyMembership.left_at__isnull=True` filter in payments/signals.py (field doesn't exist; was silent FieldError)
- ExternalCalendarAccount.update_or_create assigning to access_token/refresh_token Python properties instead of underlying `_access_token` fields
- `family_id` str → UUID at filter boundaries (defensive try/except where validation wasn't upstream)
- Heterogeneous dicts converted to TypedDicts (seed scripts, weekly digest)
- celery apply_async args=[list] → args=(tuple,)

**Config:** `mypy.ini` set to `strict = True` with `disallow_subclassing_any = False` (taggit/allauth/channels lack stubs); 18 apps still have opt-out blocks listing the strict flags they don't yet meet. Promote an app by deleting its block and fixing the remaining errors.

**Patterns established** (saved to memory):
- Django generic classes (ModelAdmin, UUIDField) not subscriptable at runtime: `TYPE_CHECKING` alias
- Celery bound tasks: `self: Task[Any, Any]`
- Test fixtures: `def fixture(db: None) -> ReturnType`

**Commits:**
- `cc1baa65` chore(typing): pre-strict fixes — real bugs, unused ignores, redundant casts
- `3bad29e2` chore(typing): enable mypy strict globally with per-app opt-outs, make webhooks strict-clean
- `d5008b84` chore(typing): make core/ app strict-clean
- `ac8c254d` chore(typing): make payments/ app strict-clean

Remaining: 18 apps (notes, frames, services_scheduler, regions, meals, recipes, family_scheduler, famstream, holiday_showcase, mobile, notifications, organize, calendars, groceries, households, family_agent, users, trips, events). Sized smallest-first. Memory at `project_mypy_strict.md` documents state and patterns for next session.
